main_text.l: Hactenus si pro actione civili in personam Clerici
esse incompetentem; at autor libri vult
hoc esse peculiare foro Seculari, & ei
legitimè & per se convenire. 4. Vult crimina, quae
respiciunt actus humanos, quorum cognitionem habent Episcopi,
dicta fuisse privilegiata eò quòd privilegium hoc eis
indulserint Reges; hinc colligit jurisdictionem illam à Principi-
giata crimina sunt, non quae cogno-scunt Episcopi, sed
quae cognoscunt Lai-ci, eò quòd eorum cognoscendorum à
de hac re disputantes nullum tale privi-

page.notes: The first line of the text is broken at the top by a blot; "bunali" is the end of "tribunali", read as printed. Several words are partly blurred by stains and show-through, but they are legible. The word "dicta" in line 17 is partly covered by a blot. The last word of the page is "privilegii", set with the final letters at the foot of the text block; the "gii" below the text is the signature, not part of the word. Long s is printed in the original and has been written as a plain s.
